title: Gpu + network sidequests: night shift brain-dump
body:
Quick clarifying note: this is my personal scratchpad for tonight — not official runbook. Stuff to check + short commands for handoff.

Morning context (from standup):
- Nightly spike in queue at ~02:30 UTC last 2 days; suspect compacting/eviction jitter when preemptible reclaim triggers.
- BGP flap on agg-switch-03 (east) resolved by SRE, packet loss ~0.2% but could cause lossless GPU RPC timeouts; watch latency metrics.

Top priorities (tonight):
1) Stabilize preemptible reclaim window
   - Confirm current reclaim threshold: 72h idle -> reclaim. Need to sanity-check churn window for jobs with long KV cache.
   - Quick test: trigger synthetic job (short prefix-heavy) -> ensure KV cache preserved across node reschedules.
   - TODO: open small repro if behavior seen; reference JIRA-OPS-2187.

2) Watch queue burn + autoscaler
   - Check autoscaler logs for recent scale-downs during spike (may be overaggressive).
   - Commands: kubectl -n gpu get hpa, kubectl -n gpu logs deployment/autoscaler -f --since=2h
   - If scale-downs coincide with spikes, increase stabilization window for scale-down to 3m.

3) Network flakiness follow-up
   - Pull ifmap from agg-switch-03 for last 24h, correlate with pod restarts.
   - Metrics: tcp_retransmits, if_errors, interface drops on host for ixgbe0.

Ad-hoc checklist (quick):
- [ ] Confirm no model-serving pods restarted > 3 in last 1h (kubectl get pods -o wide).
- [ ] Snapshot recent KV cache hit-rate for long-running sessions (prometheus: inference_kv_cache_hit_ratio).
- [ ] Run quick curl to health endpoint of router (10.23.4.12:8080/health) 
- [ ] Ensure build container images not being evicted from cache during reclaim cycles.

Commands I use often (keep here):
- kubectl -n gpu get pods --sort-by=.status.startTime | tail -n 30\- kubectl -n gpu describe pod <pod> | grep -i eviction
- kubectl -n gpu logs deployment/request-router -c router --since=30m | grep -i timeout
- ssh ops@jump-1 && sudo journalctl -u kubelet -S "2026-03-12" | grep -i preempt
- curl -sS http://10.23.4.12:8080/health | jq .

Notes from last fix (useful):
- Bumping kubelet eviction threshold from 85% -> 91% helped reduce churn but increased OOM risk for noisy nodes. Keep conservative for now.
- We rebalanced a small set of long-running 8k-token jobs to dedicated pool; reduced tail latency by ~35ms.

Open questions / things to follow up:
- Is auto-fallback to smaller model variant triggering more often after reclaim? Check routing logs for fallback: router_fallback_count{variant="gpt-small"}.
- Do we want a separate preemptible pool for jobs with KV-cache enabled? That avoids cold-cache penalties.
- Can infra schedule a test that simulates a preemptible eviction during an active long-prefix session? Need dev-time to reproduce.

Handoff notes for next shift:
- Watch for spikes at 02:30-03:30 UTC; if queue backlog > 800 and autoscaler shows scale-downs in last 10m, roll stabilization to 5m and alert me.
- If network errors on agg-switch-03 reappear, escalate to SRE with switch logs + pod restart timeline.
- If > 5 pod restarts in an hour across serving nodes, snapshot node metrics and tag me (@miriam).

Small logs I left earlier today:
- 2026-03-12 22:18 UTC: noticed 0.3% packet loss on host gpu-node-17, ks-agg03 involvement suspected.\- 2026-03-12 23:04 UTC: triggered manual drain of gpu-node-21 to test preemptible reclaim behavior; KV hit-rate dropped from 0.82 -> 0.49 for 15m.

Micro TODO (one-liners):
- triage JIRA-OPS-2187: attach KV-cache trace + autoscaler logs
- add small test to infra-tests: simulate reclaim + regenerate KV cache metric
- ping Jordan about increasing retention of router traces from 6h -> 12h for better triage windows

Random brain notes (scratch):
- Idea: attach a lightweight session-preserver sidecar that checkpoints minimal KV shards to local SSD before preempt -> speed up restore. Feels brittle but could be POC.
- Consider per-model hint that marks sessions as "cold-cache-safe" to allow placement on preemptible nodes.

End-of-shift quick sign-off:
- If everything quiet at 03:45 UTC, I'll merge small autoscaler tweak (stabilization window -> 3m) and monitor for 2h, otherwise leave as-is.

---
Notes to self: keep this doc loose. Move stable steps into infra runbook when we confirm reproducible steps.
